henry.title: Ancient Engineers of Chaco Canyon
henry.intro: Over 1,000 years ago Ancestral Puebloans in New Mexico built Pueblo Bonito, with hundreds of rooms — without metal tools!
steps: Explore the Chaco Culture NPS site.
worksheet: About how long ago was Chaco a major center?
What materials did they build with?
Why do you think they aligned buildings with the sun and moon?
Sketch a floor plan of a 5-room pueblo.
What engineering problem would be hardest without metal tools?
links: Look at the photos and read about the Great Houses.

frankie.title: Long-Ago Homes
frankie.intro: Long ago, people in New Mexico built homes out of stone and mud. Super strong!
steps: Look at Chaco pictures with a grown-up.
worksheet: Draw a house made of bricks 🧱
